d: Why did Gautama Buddha choose Sarnath to deliver his first sermon after attaining enlightenment at Bodh Gaya? In this episode of The Lallantop's Tarikh discover the fascinating history of Sarnath, one of the four holiest Buddhist pilgrimage sites in the world. Explore the Dhamek Stupa, Ashoka Pillar, Lion Capital, Chaukhandi Stupa, ancient Buddhist monasteries and the origins of Buddhism. Travel through the history of Emperor Ashoka, the Chinese traveller Xuanzang, the Gupta Empire and the archaeological discoveries that brought Sarnath back to the world's attention. Also discover…
